content.text: About to report to sqlite people:
appears to workaround the issue with TSAN, but not valgrind.
It still reproduces on Ubuntu 18.04 with:
Reported to sqlite forum and discussing with them
This appears to be a new limitation with SQLITE_DEBUG. THAT creates these races. In the process of switching to a better, more targetted workaround.
cleanup writes to BUILD-OUT.txt; dont write SQLITE_DEBUG if qStroika_FeatureSupported_Valgrind or TSAN
Fix was to set the SQLITE_DEBUG flag more carefully - doesnt work with valgrind or tsan.
Switching from SQLITE 3.36.0 to 3.37.0 on UNIX with TSAN produces race errors.
Read of size 4 at 0x55c2f79772f8 by thread T4 (mutexes: write M509514):
Previous write of size 4 at 0x55c2f79772f8 by thread T3 (mutexes: write M508861):
Location is global 'sqlite3CoverageCounter' of size 4 at 0x55c2f79772f8 (Test36+0x0000083cb2f8)
Thread T4 'Write Checks' (tid=2108454, running) created by main thread at:
Thread T3 'Update Employee' (tid=2108453, running) created by main thread at:
it appears each connection is locking its own mutex when accessing COMMON data structures (shared between threads).
From the TSAN report, the issue appears to be:
Read of size 4 at 0x55c2f79772f8 by thread T4 (mutexes: write M509514):
Previous write of size 4 at 0x55c2f79772f8 by thread T3 (mutexes: write M508861):
